description: List a project's forms with their questions and settings: contact forms, quote requests, signups and booking forms. Use a form's id with replo_form_responses_list to read what people sent, or with replo_form_summary_get for totals per question. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").
